judging_guidance: Grade the mechanism investigation and causal fit rather than the literal names of APIs or files. Source attribution may be a tool-read trace or an explicit local citation. A well-supported alternative is acceptable. A short recommendation can earn full credit; the test is not whether the solver produces lengthy research notes.

criteria.description: Inspects relevant references beyond the familiar listing API and explains an alternative mechanism from the supplied guarantees, with identifiable source attribution.

Relates snapshot/journal or another justified design to coherent revisions, rename/delete coverage, interrupted catch-up and normal incremental transfer, including cursor expiry and atomic local progress.
Compares listing and notification limitations without manufacturing features; states residual implementation uncertainties and does not equate documentation with measured behavior.
Chooses a bounded experiment containing reconnect, rename/delete and interrupted application, with an observable coherent final revision and a failure condition.

critical_failures.description: Commits to the familiar poll mechanism without investigating the provided alternative references while asserting it meets all required properties.
Claims notifications alone ensure complete durable synchronization despite their supplied loss and repetition behavior.
Invents unavailable consistency/resume guarantees or reports an unperformed integration experiment as passed.
